name: Abdul Hamid Shuvo
title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Staff-level product engineer with 16+ years in software — Dwetech from 2009 through 2016 (60+ international client projects) and 9+ years at Chaldal (YC S15). Broad ownership across shopper products, mobile apps, logistics, and internal platforms, with consistent delivery from zero-to-production under real-world constraints.
strengths: Frontend and mobile product ownership across React, React Native, Next.js, TypeScript, and accessibility-minded UI.
Production systems judgment from grocery, logistics, payments, dispatch, and unstable-network field operations.
Backend and platform fluency with F#, .NET, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Redis, PHP, and MySQL.
Cross-functional delivery: product shaping, release management, code review, mentoring, regulatory documentation, and stakeholder communication.

highlights: Joined when Chaldal had minimal desktop web, no mobile web, and no production native shopper apps; built the mobile web from zero and evolved the production shopper web experience.
Built the original Android and iOS Chaldal shopper apps from the ground up as primary engineer, with ongoing ownership across releases and shopper-stack reliability.
Owned Chalao consumer ride-sharing product work under Chaldal, including app delivery plus BRTA meetings, documentation, and licensing/enlistment work.
Own Chalao Driver, a React Native logistics app for Chaldal's last-mile delivery network, designed around dispatch pressure, unreliable connectivity, location accuracy, and Play Store releases.
Shipped Protocol for 1,000+ internal users and contributed to Subject / EggShell frontend architecture and reusable product foundations.
Co-founded a software company and delivered 60+ projects for clients across the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia.
Built client systems across PHP, JavaScript, CMS ecosystems, integrations, automation-heavy workflows, and productized internal tools.
Maintained a 5.0 rating across 63 completed Freelancer.com projects, including long-running repeat enterprise engagements.
